arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_transactions_over_2000 FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND amount_usd_cents > 200000
arguments.explanation: Counts all online transactions with an amount strictly greater than $2,000, across the full data period.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, labelled or not, across the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
